caption: The drawing features a single, transparent goblet positioned upright and centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The goblet has a rounded bowl with slight vertical divisions and contains etched fern-like leaf patterns on its surface. The rim of the bowl is marked by a double line, and the stem is cylindrical and connects to a flat, circular base. The drawing is done in grayscale, employing various shades of gray and black to depict shading, contours, and reflections, with no use of color. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the glass object as the primary subject.
title: Goblet
